purpose: Research evaluation of amendment A1 (7-day cooldown measured from the END of the previous markdown window) against the original Phase 2 rule and against unchanged prices. SIMULATED RESEARCH - NOT VALIDATED FOR LIVE USE. Passing is not commercial proof.

source.approval: A1 evaluation approved by the project owner on 2026-10-24
source.preliminary_exposure: The original Phase 2 results were seen in full. The A1 impact analysis on the saved original run (26 SC3 selections in 19 lines would be blocked; SC1/SC2/SF75 unaffected) and a 5-line SC3 test replay were seen. No full A1 outcome had been simulated when this policy was frozen. The comparison is therefore exploratory.

replay_assumption_set.role: replay values, identical to the protected comparison

pricing_assumption_set.role: A1 pricing belief, guards (cooldown from end of previous window) and conventions

original_criteria.note: Applied to A1 exactly as frozen in EP-PH2-2026-10-23-v1, unchanged

prerequisites_per_scenario.E1: Pricing off reproduces the protected P2 decisions, deliveries and weekly outputs exactly (CSV round trip)
prerequisites_per_scenario.E2: Pricing on with fixed orders and no markdown possible reproduces the pricing-off decisions, deliveries, daily and weekly outputs exactly
prerequisites_per_scenario.E3: In-loop eligibility, blockers, waste class, batch dates, investigate-by day and at-risk units equal the saved Markdown review for every decision

hard_gates_every_priced_run.G1: Unit conservation holds on every simulated day (replay.check_conservation)
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G2: Ordering unchanged: decisions and deliveries identical to the pricing-off pass
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G3: Markdown only and price bounds: price never above the reference price; markdowns are permitted steps, at most the maximum markdown, and keep the margin floor
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G4: Every selected markdown was eligible at its decision; at least 7 days between selections per line; at most 2 selections in any rolling 28 days; no overlapping windows; windows start on or after the decision day
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G5: Chronology: no demand read before its decision; markdown days only inside selected windows
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G6: Labels: every pricing record SIMULATED / HYPOTHETICAL_UNAPPROVED / NOT_EXECUTED with no approval or proposal id; every selection SIMULATED_AS_IF_APPROVED and PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW
hard_gates_every_priced_run.G7: Belief and truth separated: under the no-response truth the daily demand equals the baseline demand on every day

measures.delta: priced minus baseline, summed over all series and simulated days of the scenario
measures.gross_profit: revenue at the price in force - assumed cost of units received - disposal cost (v6 disposal 0%); costs are identical in paired runs
measures.baseline_expired_cost: baseline expired units x assumed unit cost (reference price x (1 - assumed margin))
harms: markdown events and mandatory reviews created

thresholds_per_adoption_scenario.T1_R2_CENTRAL: expired units fall (delta < 0) and gross profit does not fall (delta >= 0)
thresholds_per_adoption_scenario.T3_R1_LOW: gross-profit loss at most 10% of the baseline expired cost (delta >= -0.10 x baseline_expired_cost)
thresholds_per_adoption_scenario.T4_R0_NO_RESPONSE: gross-profit loss at most 25% of the baseline expired cost (delta >= -0.25 x baseline_expired_cost)
thresholds_per_adoption_scenario.T5_ALL_TRUE_RESPONSES: illustrative unmet units rise by at most 0.5% of baseline sold units
thresholds_per_adoption_scenario.not_applicable: A threshold is NOT_APPLICABLE (neither pass nor fail) when no markdown was selected for that scenario and true response

original_criteria.outcome_rule: MEETS_PREREGISTERED_RESEARCH_CRITERIA only if every prerequisite and hard gate passes in every scenario and every applicable threshold passes in SC1, SC2 and SC3; otherwise DOES_NOT_MEET_PREREGISTERED_RESEARCH_CRITERIA. SF75 is reported, not used. Either outcome is a research result only.

a1_specific_criteria.R0_original_reproduced: The frozen v1.3 simulator with v7 re-run now reproduces the protected original run's pricing decisions exactly in every scenario and true response (so the comparison is against valid original results)
a1_specific_criteria.G8_a1_cooldown: Every repeat markdown on a line starts at least 8 days after the previous window ended (7 complete days without a markdown)
comparison_measures: lines where gross profit rose / fell

preference_rule.PA: Every prerequisite, every original hard gate G1-G7, G8 and R0_original_reproduced pass
preference_rule.PB: A1 meets the original thresholds T1-T5 (PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE) in SC1, SC2 and SC3
preference_rule.PC_harm_weak_response: In each of SC1, SC2 and SC3, under R0 and under R1, A1's gross-profit change is at least the original's (A1 loses no more money when customers respond weakly or not at all)
preference_rule.PD_benefit_retention_central: Summed over SC1-SC3 under R2, A1 keeps at least 75% of the original's gross-profit gain and at least 75% of the original's reduction in expired units
preference_rule.PE_unmet: Summed over SC1-SC3, under every true response, A1's increase in illustrative unmet units is no larger than the original's
preference_rule.outcome: A1_PREFERRED_RESEARCH_COOLDOWN only if PA, PB, PC, PD and PE all hold; otherwise ORIGINAL_RULE_RETAINED_AS_PREFERRED, with the failed parts listed. SF75 is reported, not used. Either outcome is a research result only.

reporting: Original and A1 results are reported side by side with the research run that supplies each. Thresholds and rules are not changed after results are seen.
